parameters.memo_body: As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly integrated into our daily lives, the importance of prioritizing in AI safety cannot be overstated. Building AI systems with robust safety mechanisms ensures that these technologies function as intended, mitigate potential risks, and align with ethical principles. From self-driving cars to medical diagnostics, safety not only protects users but also builds trust in the technology. Developers must consider scenarios where systems might fail or be misused and create safeguards to prevent harm. By embedding safety as a core principle in AI design and deployment, we can unlock its full potential while minimizing unintended consequences. Let us work collectively to ensure that the future of AI is both innovative and secure.

goal_achievement_criteria.description: A text message (containing all of the target keywords) is sent to the target receiver
